text: On February 9, 2017, the applicant applied to the Committee of Adjustment (Applications B0071/15NY, B0014/16NY, A1129/15NY, A1130/15NY, A0260/16NY) to obtain consent to sever the properties at 52 and 56 Norton Avenue into three undersized residential lots and for minor variances from Zoning By-laws 7625 and 569-2013 to permit the construction of a new two-storey dwelling on each of the proposed severed lots. The applications were refused by the Committee and appealed to the Ontario Municipal Board by the applicant. At its meeting on May 24, 2017, City Council authorized the City Solicitor and appropriate staff to attend the hearing and oppose the proposed consent and minor variances in Applications B0071/15NY, B0014/16NY, A1129/15NY, A1130/15NY, A0260/16NY. The applicant, however, failed to appeal all of the minor variance applications. Subsequently, the applicant has now reapplied to…

City Council on April 24, 25, 26 and 27, 2018, adopted the following: 1. City Council authorize the City Solicitor, along with appropriate City Staff, to attend the Local Planning Appeal Tribunal and to retain outside consultants, as necessary, in order to oppose the applicant’s appeal of the Committee of Adjustment, North York Panel, decisions refusing the consent and minor variances requested in Applications B0071/15NY, B0014/16NY, A1108/17NY, A0053/18NY, A0054/18NY respecting 52 and 56 Norton Avenue.
